picks.title: UltraDiff: Differentiable Ray Tracing in Ultrasound for Shape Optimization
picks.takeaway: 将可微渲染扩展到超声，用蒙特卡洛估计器对组织界面形状做梯度优化
picks.why: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 接收，超声成像物理建模与逆问题结合

picks.title: Ultrasound Operator Guidance Using World Modeling and Retrieval Based Action Planning
picks.takeaway: 基于 V-JEPA 2.1 的世界模型+检索，指导操作者将探头移向目标切面
picks.why: 面向真实超声操作者培训缺口，含 11 页实验与定量评估

picks.title: Physics-Grounded Objective-Conditioned Deep Beamforming for Adaptive Resolution-Contrast Control in Plane-Wave Ultrasound Imaging
picks.takeaway: 从单平面波通道数据预测空间变化接收变迹权重，实现分辨率-对比度可控波束形成
picks.why: 基于原始通道数据与物理约束，非合成降采样，含真实波束形成验证
